searchText: b"h — 05 — design system plan (palace metaphor = first class principle) 1. the metaphor, stated as law "like walking through a palace. but better." heichelos literally means palaces — the metaphor is not decoration, it is the design principle. arrival: entering a heichel feels like stepping through grand doors. the identity hero lands with weight, then opens into the space. never a dashboard that just appears. every major route has an entrance sequence with presence. architecture: halls → chambers → scrolls. grand hall (heichel root), chambers (series / sub series), scrolls (posts). information hierarchy reads as palace architecture. navigation transitions feel like moving through rooms: forward motion into spaces, graceful return, route continuity. depth and light: the futuristic material language — deep midnight, cyan intelligence, gold warmth, glass — creates palatial depth. layered surfaces, light suggesting vastness, parallax conveying architecture. grandeur through space and light, never ornament spam. "but better": a living palace, not a museum. alive with recent learning, community presence, continuing paths. every chamber shows signs of life — or a truthful, elegant quiet when empty. procession: core journeys (heichel → series → post → lens → community) feel like a guided procession — one obvious next step, momentum, no getting lost. breadcrumbs are the thread back through the rooms. metaphor test (in the embarrassment walk): does this feel like processing through a palace, or clicking through an admin panel? admin panel = redesign. 2. palette — vivid extreme professional rich midnight / cyan / violet / gold, used with intent. bold heroes, deep color, confident scale. never neon everywhere or glow for glow's sake. timid / washed out = defect. gold is warmth (arrival, identity, sacred emphasis); cyan is intelligence (data, signals, interactive); violet is depth (chambers, transitions); midnight is the stone of the palace (the base everything is carved from). 3. motion / alive bar transform/opacity only; 60fps budget; every animation ships a reduced motion counterpart (stillness, not lesser motion). thriving content: real data, real counts, real progress. truthful empty states where data is absent. shared language: staggered card entrances, tactile press, route continuity — identical vocabulary in heichel, reader, and social. 4. global top nav (gating check) persistent on every route. one tap home from everywhere — this gates the whole mission. mobile: safe area insets, touch targets ≥ 44px, thumb reachable. 5. breadth track whole site chrome under the shared tokens — heichelos is the focus, but the rest of the site must read as the same palace, not adjacent buildings. 6. css governance (source law) classify every stylesheet: active / compatibility / dormant / legacy / dead. no !important wars. social scoped under .awtsmoos social root. code: read before writing, rewrite complete files, tabs, no minify, 120 line modules, read after write, preserve public contracts or trace every consumer.

"not basic" bar enforced. sub series navigation: parent → sub series → posts, breadcrumbs, contextual movement, beautiful at 390/430. post listings: meaningful ordering, metadata hierarchy, continue reading / recently visited signals. search/filter at listing level where useful. truthful loading/empty/error states at every level; staggered entrances, tactile press, route continuity. palace metaphor throughout: arrival with weight, halls → chambers → scrolls, depth and light, living palace, procession, metaphor test. p2 — reader (03) auto scroll contract lock in: start=immediate continuous motion, stop=stop and stay, no countdown, no phantom stops, real vessel measured. interval measurement proven in a real post vessel (real browser). scribe's lens default hierarchy proof at 390 and 430. new regression test files (none exist); full test: list, headless node. p3 — social (04) composer de duplication proof (idempotency key, single flight, new tests). hub route by route: profiles, search, notifications — each with arrival, real data, truthful empties, one tap home, motion language. p4 — design system sweep (05, breadth track) whole site chrome under shared tokens; css classification active/compatibility/dormant/legacy/dead; kill !important wars by scoping; social stays under .awtsmoos social root. global top nav: persistent, one tap home from every route (gating check), safe area + 44px targets. vivid extreme professional pass: bold heroes, midnight/cyan/violet/gold with intent; timid/washed out treated as defect. p5 — verification matrix (07) real browser pass on every route; 390/430/desktop; rtl; reduced motion; keyboard only. embarrassment walk + metaphor test + takeover tests. p6 — clean release (gates, then ship) 1. fresh isolated worktree from origin/main — never the dirty shared tree. 2. exact file set; full test: green; review gates. 3. commit; fast forward push only (no force, no merge commits). 4. read scripts/bhrelease.mjs first, then npm run bh on the remote ssh host. 5. verify public production in a real browser + public sha verification. standing rules for every worker, every phase read before writing; rewrite complete files; tabs; no minify; 120 line modules; read after write; preserve public contracts or trace consumers. restart the server after every change (no watcher). embarrassment + takeover tests run continuously — not a final phase. tunnel 409/502s are transient: wait 15s, refresh route, retry up to 4x; blocked only if down 5 min. never hard code db backed names/titles in presentation; never fabricate data for cards; truthful elegant empty states.

searchText: b"h — 07 — browser verification plan subagents cannot drive a live browser. every item below is specified here so the parent can delegate it to an eligible browser worker. never claim a site visit from a fetched page — only from a real browser session. routes to walk (every one, in order — the procession) 1. / → 2. /heichelos → 3. /heichelos/ikar (grand hall) → 4. series (chamber) → 5. sub series (deeper chamber) → 6. post (scroll) → 7. scribe's lens → 8. social hub → 9. profile → 10. search → 11. notifications. per route checks boot: heichel boot title and discovery list populated from the semantic model on first paint (p0 gate, re verified after every phase). listings: rich discovery cards — not a file browser, not a generic grid. counts, recency, progress, featured paths where data exists; elegant quiet where it does not. the "not basic" bar. navigation: breadcrumbs at every depth; contextual movement; one tap home from every route (gating check — a single failure fails the track). reader: auto scroll start=immediate continuous motion, stop=stop and stay, in a real post vessel; interval measurement recorded; no countdown, no phantom stops. scribe's lens hierarchy at 390 and 430. social: composer cannot double post (double tap proof); profiles/search/ notifications render real data with truthful empties. states: loading, empty, and error states are truthful and elegant on every level — force each one (throttle, empty db slice, killed api) and look. matrix (each route × each condition) widths: 390, 430, desktop. safe area + 44px targets on mobile. rtl layout; reduced motion (stillness everywhere motion was); keyboard only navigation (focus visible, logical order, no traps). motion: transform/opacity only, 60fps feel, staggered entrances, tactile press, route continuity (forward pushes in, back returns gracefully). the embarrassment walk (continuous, every worker) walk the procession as a first time visitor. anything cheap, broken, confusing, or timid gets filed immediately — not "later". metaphor test on every route: does this feel like processing through a palace, or clicking through an admin panel? admin panel = redesign. takeover tests run continuously: hand the session to a fresh eye and watch where they stumble; fix what they find. production verification (after npm run bh) public production in a real browser: full procession, boot gate, nav gate. public sha verification: the deployed commit matches the released commit.
